mapper.select: SELECT state, last_success AS lastSuccess, range_start AS rangeStart, range_end AS rangeEnd, row_count AS rowCount, updated_at AS updatedAt, (state='RUNNING' AND updated_at > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 35 MINUTE)) AS running FROM procurement_pending_po_sync WHERE id=1
mapper.update: UPDATE procurement_pending_po_sync SET state='RUNNING', updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=1
UPDATE procurement_pending_po_sync SET state='FAILED', updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=1
UPDATE procurement_pending_po_sync SET state='SUCCESS', last_success=NOW(), range_start=#{from}, range_end=#{to}, row_count=#{count}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=1
mapper.sql: CASE UPPER(TRIM(p.site)) WHEN '德国' THEN 'DE' WHEN '英国' THEN 'UK' WHEN 'GB' THEN 'UK' WHEN '美国' THEN 'US' ELSE UPPER(TRIM(p.site)) END
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.site!='UNKNOWN' THEN s.order_sn END) AS orderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.site='UNKNOWN' THEN s.order_sn END) AS unclassifiedCount, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.site!='UNKNOWN' THEN s.order_status END ORDER BY s.order_status SEPARATOR '、') AS orderStatus, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.site!='UNKNOWN' THEN s.arrival_status END ORDER BY s.arrival_status SEPARATOR '、') AS arrivalStatus, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.site!='UNKNOWN' THEN s.pay_status END ORDER BY s.pay_status SEPARATOR '、') AS payStatus FROM procurement_pending_purchase p LEFT JOIN procurement_pending_po_item s ON s.sku=UPPER(TRIM(p.sku)) AND (s.site=() OR s.site='UNKNOWN') AND s.source_created >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) WHERE p.id IN #{id} GROUP BY p.id

SELECT s.order_sn AS orderSn,s.sku,s.site,s.warehouse_name AS warehouseName,s.supplier_name AS supplierName, s.item_id AS itemId,s.order_status AS orderStatus,s.arrival_status AS arrivalStatus,s.pay_status AS payStatus, s.quantity_real AS quantityReal,s.quantity_entry AS quantityEntry,s.quantity_receive AS quantityReceive, s.source_created AS sourceCreated,s.source_updated AS sourceUpdated,s.synced_at AS syncedAt FROM procurement_pending_purchase p JOIN procurement_pending_po_item s ON s.sku=UPPER(TRIM(p.sku)) AND (s.site=() OR s.site='UNKNOWN') WHERE p.id=#{id} AND s.source_created >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) ORDER BY s.site='UNKNOWN', s.source_created DESC, s.order_sn, s.item_id
